v1.1.4 Update
- Reduced click delays in collection displays, including Signal Archive's Cases, Index, and Feed screens. Region sizing, scrollbar updates, and font checks now run in batches to avoid repeated layout work.
- Theme styles now activate only for themes used by open pages, their parts, and transition previews. Mixed-theme pages and both editors keep their existing appearance and animations.

announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.1.4
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.1.4

  • Reduced click delays in collection displays, including Signal Archive's Cases, Index, and Feed screens. Region sizing, scrollbar updates, and font checks now run in batches to avoid repeated layout work.
  • Theme styles now activate only for themes used by open pages, their parts, and transition previews. Mixed-theme pages and both editors keep their existing appearance and animations.
